text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- Confectioners Kras, Zvecevo and Kandit halt their production of goods for export following the government's ban on sugar import.

- Why are the Serbs from Eastern Slavonia blocking the publishing of the war criminals list? In a statement issued by the local executive council it was said that the details of the list should not be revealed until the Serb side assesses its content.
- A new thermal power plant may be built near Karlobag using $1 billion of U.S. capital.
- The Air Bosna carrier plane touched down at the Zagreb airport on Thursday for the first time.
- There exist speculations that the arrest of Mladen Naletilic-Tuta might have something to do with a 1993 Mostar abducton he was involved in. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
